messages.subject: Project Zephyr — Licensor counter-mark-up (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Our counter attached (v3, tracked against your v2). The moves:

- Clause 8.3 liability cap: we've come down to £9m (from your £10m), with the fee and confidentiality carve-outs retained.
- Schedule 3 royalty: rate to 4.5% and cap held at £2.0m (your 4.0%/£2.5m didn't work for us on the modelling).
- Clause 2.2 exclusivity: back to three years per the term sheet — we can't justify five.

We think this is close. Shall we aim to finalise next week and target signature for the 28th?

James

James Osei

messages.plaintextBody:
James,

We can live with this. £9m cap accepted; 4.5% / £2.0m royalty accepted; and we'll accept three years' exclusivity on the basis the field definition stays as drafted. Subject to client sign-off, treat the commercials as agreed. Let's finalise the execution version for the 28th.

Alistair
